1.why: Source only mentions a ramp belay in approach directions, never as the end of pitch 1; not clearly the stored pitch

P2.why: Source pitch 2: over chockstone, squeezed 25 more feet up a narrow chimney to another anchor; 'fixed' not stated so removed
P2.text: At the top of the narrow chimney, about 25 feet above the chockstone.

2.why: Source P2 (offwidth): belay on a small stance with horizontal crack for feet just above
2.text: A small stance just above the offwidth, with a horizontal crack to stand on.

3.why: Source P3: belay at slung block on right about 30 ft below headwall in dihedral; MP: belay before route forces you left
3.text: A slung block on the right in the dihedral, about 30 feet under the headwall, before the route pushes left.

4.why: Source P4: blind step left over arete, traverse left on good cracks to sloping ledge directly below thin hands crack; stored notes match
4.text: A sloping ledge reached by moving left on good cracks, directly under the steep thin-hands crack.

5.why: Source P5 (5.10): belay at small good stance below final offwidth section, bolt there; MP says bolted belay
5.text: A small ledge with a bolted anchor at the top of the crack, under the last offwidth section.

P1-2.why: Source P2: climb cracks to recessed belay at base of another crack/corner system
P1-2.text: In a recessed spot at the base of the next crack and corner system, reached by climbing the cracks.

P3.why: Source P3: crack to roof, through roof to small ledge belay
P3.text: On a small ledge just above the roof, once you have pulled through it.

P13.why: Source P13: strenuous left-facing corner/crack to another ledge on the buttress crest
P13.text: On a ledge up on the crest of the buttress, at the top of the corner.

P18.why: Source P18: long series of thin cracks to a small stance
P18.text: On a small stance at the top of the long series of thin cracks.
